subject: relayindex.dev

hypothesis.null_hypothesis: Agents utilizing RelayIndex live status envelopes achieve no statistically significant reduction in runtime tool-call errors or latency over naive official registry scrapers.
hypothesis.alternative_hypothesis: Agents routing through RelayIndex experience >= 40% fewer runtime connection failures and avoid 100% of tombstoned/deprecated servers.

disconfirming_evidence_rules: If official MCP registry implements native push notifications, edge caching, and cryptographic verification with 99.99% uptime, eliminating the need for an external delta ledger.
If multi-agent harnesses overwhelmingly adopt static tool bundles rather than dynamic runtime discovery.

trial_parameters.metric_primary: Tool invocation success rate on newly published or updated MCP servers
